summary.text: Abi Boatman (Elle Abigail Boatman) is a Democratic state representative from Kansas House District 86 who was appointed in January 2026 and is seeking election on November 3, 2026.
She is a U.S. Air Force veteran and court transcriptionist.

paragraphs.text: Elle Abigail Boatman, who is also known as Abi, served in the U.S. Air Force from 2001 to 2011.
She graduated from Dayton Christian High School in 1998 and earned a bachelor's degree focusing on women's studies, sociology and communications from Wichita State University in 2015.

Her career experience includes working as a court transcriptionist and as a financial aid administrative specialist and events coordinator for Wichita State University, and she co-founded the Wichita Transgender Community Network.
Democratic precinct committee members from District 86 appointed Boatman to the Kansas House on January 8, 2026, to replace Silas Miller.
Kevin Thompson is the Republican candidate for the seat in the November 2026 general election.
